statement: The Target 2035 roadmap identifies fragmented, non-standardized public bioactivity data and lack of high-quality inactive compounds as major constraints, and proposes large open positive/negative binding datasets with metadata, quality control and orthogonal experimental verification.
locator: Abstract and data-quality sections; Nature Reviews Chemistry 9, 634–645 (2025)
notes: Strong evidence that supervision quality is a first-class bottleneck, not only model architecture.
